headline: No fluff. Here's the exact path I'd follow if I started today.
caption:
Everyone asks me: "Where do I start with Machine Learning?"

The internet is full of bloated 12-month roadmaps that will make you quit before you even build your first model. You don't need to learn every math theorem or 5 different frameworks.

Here is the exact, lean, and practical roadmap I would follow if I had to start completely from scratch today.

Swipe to see the timeline, tools, and the 5 common detours you must avoid. 👉

What phase of the roadmap are you currently in? Let me know below! 👇
